answer.summary: Liu cautions against treating AI as a superficial add-on: companies should rethink how to deliver their mission with an AI-native approach and honestly assess whether their legacy assets help.

sections.heading: The mistake to avoid
sections.content: Don’t simply add AI branding and a couple of AI features, then call the adaptation done. Liu recommends starting with a clean-slate question: if founding the company today with the same mission, how would you execute it using a fully AI-native approach? Then assess whether the existing product and business provide useful building blocks—or whether the legacy assets leave you worse off than starting from scratch. He says the answer depends on the product.

judgment.explanation: The answer accurately attributes Liu’s warning to him: merely adding AI marketing and a few features is not enough. It also includes his recommendation to rethink the mission with a fully AI-native approach and assess the value of existing assets, all supported by S1.
